introText: Ghost Tequila has catalyzed a wave of spicy cocktail creativity and culturally savvy moments across recipes, bars, UGC, and media. It’s become a shorthand for “make it spicy” in drinks and celebrations.

stats.label: On-Premise Presence
stats.trend: Boston Halloween special; Spicy Paloma listings

highlights.title: Recipes
highlights.description: Signature and user-created spicy cocktails (Perfectly Spicy Margarita, Ghost Paloma) circulate widely, with Pinterest boards compiling dozens of ideas.

highlights.title: Bar Menus
highlights.description: Bars and restaurants feature Ghost in heat-forward specials like Boston’s Halloween ‘Ghost Pepperita’ and spicy Palomas.

highlights.title: UGC Photos
highlights.description: Instagram showcases stylized bottle shots with smoke, dried ghost peppers, and Day of the Dead/Halloween setups, reinforcing the brand’s spooky-spicy persona.

highlights.title: Influencers
highlights.description: Collaborations with Cocktail Cartel and lifestyle plays like ‘Ghosted & Gorgeous’ tie the brand to dating slang and seasonal moments.

highlights.title: Awards/Media
highlights.description: ‘Death to the Margarita’ earned a Shorty Awards finalist nod, while cocktail publications have spotlighted Ghost for spicy margaritas.

closingText: From home mixology to award-nominated stunts, Ghost Tequila drives outsized cultural buzz around spicy cocktails and celebratory moments.
